name: Mikura Tagane
source: An unsuccessful sex worker. Despite working in the sex industry, she is bad at sex. Moreover, she doesn't have a very strong sex drive and is quite sexually under-explored. Tagane is irresponsible and careless in many ways. She feels guilty about many things that happened in the past and is happening now. Tagane has a ladylike-side to her, being good at making cakes.
